title: クレーンゲーム大成功！

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You could give Dia a real run for her money!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I know! It's not every day I can brag about this to Dia, so I'm absolutely going to be doing that!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll send a photo to my family… and maybe my classmates too! Or I could decorate the classroom with them. ♪
